items.headline: FDA approves talazoparib plus enzalutamide for earlier-stage hormone-sensitive prostate cancer
items.summary: The FDA approved combining the drugs talazoparib and enzalutamide for men whose metastatic prostate cancer still responds to hormone treatment and carries certain DNA repair gene mutations. In a large trial of about six hundred patients, the combination cut the risk of the cancer progressing or death by more than half compared with standard treatment alone.
items.why_it_matters: It lets doctors use this effective combination earlier in the disease, before the cancer becomes resistant to hormone therapy, which may help more patients live longer.
